structured_output_strategy: Prompt requests one JSON object; result.text is parsed with JSON.parse and validated by Zod. No provider-native structured output.

llm_call_sites.purpose: assessment, internal decision_facts, and optional question in one request

tests.evidence: reply/no-reply/final copy/wrong question/restart passed; semantic provenance, lifecycle, idempotency, and snapshot gaps reproduced
required data-model and test-case JSON files absent

findings.description: Policy permits retry from unvalidated model-generated decision_facts.
Source validation checks ID existence only; invented verification and unsupported facts pass.
Lifecycle-blocked cases are not consistently prechecked, finalized, or persisted.
Event IDs lack uniqueness and payload hashes; duplicates are conflicts rather than idempotent replays.
No immutable phase-two input snapshot is persisted.
Model/parse/source failures are returned as HTTP errors rather than durable review outcomes.
VoltAgent Agent is instantiated but not invoked; execution uses AI SDK directly.

semantic_hardcoding_findings.material_risk: Semantic correctness and retry prerequisites depend on unvalidated LLM extraction; source existence is incorrectly treated as sufficient validation.

recommended_next_steps: Add provenance-bound semantic validation before deterministic policy
Finalize and persist all lifecycle prechecks without LLM calls
Add transactional event idempotency and payload hashes
Persist an input snapshot per assessment
Persist model failures as review outcomes
Obtain authoritative BI JSON artifacts and run the untouched 30-case suite
Add API/browser tests and then run bounded live semantic checks
